method: Deterministic C4-symmetric rotated Chebyshev equilibrium lattice start (angle 49.398705354995535 deg, boundary offset 0.59999999999999998 * 2*pi/n, equilibrium weights) solved directly with geodesic-accelerated Marquardt-scaled Levenberg-Marquardt (no randomness); the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Antigravity (AI-assisted)
